relevance_note: The paper describes a family with HA20 'caused by a novel heterozygous TNFAIP3 p.(Lys91*) loss-of-function mutation' in carriers I-2, II-1, II-4 and III-1.
method_note: Read the whole paper; values chosen by reading and written out with a short Python script (no tables in the paper, so nothing was transcribed by script). People are labelled by pedigree position; figure 4/5 legends also call II-1 'patients 1' and III-1 '2'. Relationship of II-4 to the others is not stated. I-2 is called an 'obligate carrier' (not stated as genotyped); her variant row is included because the paper lists her among 'all carriers', but zygosity is left 'not reported'. Inheritance is 'not reported' for everyone: the pedigree implies transmission (I-2 obligate carrier; III-1 is the index's daughter) but the text never states the parental origin. Variant printed in non-standard form 'c.A271T: p.(Lys91*)' with Ensembl ENSG00000118503:ENST00000433680; recorded as printed. n_patients_reported = 4 is counted from the explicit carrier list '(I-2, II-1, II-4, III-1)'; the authors give no number. Ages 30 and 8 years are ages at blood sampling in figure legends, recorded as last evaluation. Diagnosis ages ('at an early age' for thyroiditis, 'at the age of 4 years' for JIA) are feature diagnosis ages, kept in severity_or_detail, not in onset or individual age_at_diagnosis. Wording differences, not contradictions: the figure 1 legend says 'severe autoinflammatory lung reaction' and lists 'genital papillomatosis', while Results says 'severe inflammatory lung reaction' and omits papillomatosis. Checklist: 'articular symptoms' left 'not reported' for arthritis or arthralgia (vaguer than either); anaemia not counted as autoimmune cytopenia (cause not stated); the lung reaction not counted as interstitial lung disease; psoriasis counted as a skin lesion, atrophic gastritis as GI inflammation, repeated genital HSV infections as recurrent infections. Plasma IL-18 increase (supplementary, carriers not named) not attributed to individuals. No excluded features are stated for anyone.
